combo_label: In the Bathroom × Maps & Navigation × Beatrix Potter

entries.clue: Trusting poke-bonneted duck who accepted a dinner invitation from a fox
What a monk wears daily and a bather wears briefly
Whiskered attic ruffian who rolled a kitten in dough for a roly-poly pudding
Pedestal bowl where teeth get brushed and chins shaved
Gruff Scots-named grower who tried to trap a trespassing rabbit under a sieve
Rubbery raincoat, mercifully foul-tasting to a greedy fish
Pole-to-pole line on the globe; the prime one passes through Greenwich
The line you plan from A to B before setting out
Maddening midnight metronome from a spout never quite shut
Looping line linking every point at one height
Chrome spout you twist for hot or cold
